figurative_meaning_en: Specific work based on a contract
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ঠিকা কাজ করে জীবিকা নির্বাহ করে।
গ্রামে অনেকে ঠিকা কাজের মাধ্যমে আয় করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He earns a living by doing contract work.
Many in the village make income through piecework.
note: Refers to temporary or fixed-term labor common in Bengali socioeconomic contexts
